title: EP 14 — STOP MAKING CLAUDE HUNT FOR FILES
lines: Watching Claude grep around for the file you meant?
Watching Clawd grep around, for the file you meant?
Skip it. Type @ and the filename.
Skip all that. Type the at sign, and the filename.
@slugify.py drops the whole file into the chat.
At slugify dot py, drops the whole file straight into the chat.
No searching, no waiting for it to read around.
No searching. No waiting for it to read around.
@ a folder instead, and you get its file listing.
At sign a folder instead, and you get its file listing.
Chain a few: @file1 and @file2 in one message.
Or chain a few. At file one, and at file two, in one message.
Follow for a fresh Claude Code tip every day.
Follow for a fresh Clawd Code tip, every day.
